source_descriptor_id.semantics: links this native capability record to DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR.descriptor_id

instance_id.semantics: zero-based instance within the record type's capability class; not a physical-device index

physical_device_id.semantics: groups capability descriptors supplied by the same physical module

reserved.semantics: writer emits zero; reader assigns no meaning

navigation_replay.operation_order: Sort ESTIMATOR_STEP.operation_sequence, GNSS_MEASUREMENT.receive_operation_sequence/position_operation_sequence/velocity_operation_sequence, and BARO_MEASUREMENT.operation_sequence within replay_epoch. Zero means not executed. Equal position/velocity operation IDs mean one combined insert.
navigation_replay.initial_state: INITIAL_STATE; P0 diagonal and initial velocity; attitude shared with chosen navigation algorithm
navigation_replay.prediction: ESTIMATOR_STEP references INERTIAL_INCREMENT.sequence; record order is not execution order across logger queues.
navigation_replay.measurement_timestamps: Resolved on the firmware MCU axis. Never subtract configured delay again. Position and velocity times are independent.
navigation_replay.replay_generation: Number of successful rewind/replay transactions after this operation or packet.
navigation_replay.corrected_imu: Calibrated SI inputs. Do not calibrate again. Verify grouping and coning/sculling against every INERTIAL_INCREMENT interval.
navigation_replay.reanchor: Qualified availability outage only; consistent returning observations at least 1 second, minimum sample count, exhausted bounded normal/inflation attempts; replace only selected state block, variance diagonal from actual R, affected cross covariance zero; apply at measurement time then replay forward.
navigation_replay.fidelity: Requires complete inputs and C golden validation; never infer operation timing from receive time.

nav_fusion_state_change_event.name: NAV_FUSION_STATE_CHANGE
nav_fusion_state_change_event.scope: live supervisor state transitions only; historical replay emits no side effect

eskf15_replay.initialization: ESKF15_INITIAL_STATE plus four identity-matched ESKF15_INITIAL_P_PART records.
eskf15_replay.prediction: ESKF15_BODY_INPUT calibrated body SI two subinterval means before ESKF residual bias or coning/sculling.
eskf15_replay.measurement: ESKF15_MEASUREMENT uses recorded resolved measurement/evaluation times and per-group physical/admitted/outcome evidence.
eskf15_replay.calibration_generation: Actual calibration start_sequence; distinct from INITIAL_STATE.epoch navigation preparation identity.
eskf15_replay.covariance: 15 by 15 symmetric upper triangle row-major, 120 values split into four parts of 30; missing/duplicate/conflicting parts are incomplete.
eskf15_replay.quality: NAV_QUALITY revision3; bounded satellite and window variance weighting, no position-bit veto from consistency.
eskf15_replay.fidelity: Require complete exact inputs and C numerical validation; unsupported or incomplete evidence is explicit.

sf6.name: SF6
sf6.confidence: Unavailable: no covariance, NIS or statistically optimal confidence.
sf6.delay: Use recorded resolved measurement and boundary timestamps. Previous completed IMU boundary; quantization <=20ms; reject history misses. No second delay subtraction.
sf6.height: GNSS ellipsoid relative ENU U and barometer relative preflight altitude use the same pU gain, independently once per new observation. GNSS position, GNSS velocity, then barometer; per-observation gain is rate dependent.
sf6.defaults: Initial engineering defaults, not bench tuned or optimal.
